large_json_compression: gzip above 1 MiB; original bytes retained

review.scope: SovietMilitary second selectable Extraction map; SpaceCenter remains default; no engine-source edits.
review.network: Independent packaged dedicated server and up to six clients. One rendered 1920x1080 Medium bounded client; other clients NullRHI. Not an all-client rendering or performance benchmark.
review.traversal: Only the dedicated continuous-route scenarios have zero position fixtures; their assertions require actual walking, search, transfer, exit countdown, persistence and lobby return.
review.fixtures: Door/container/AI/lifecycle scenes arrange positions. Lifecycle uses a real 120-second round override. Six-client cross-map PIE uses a SpaceCenter exit clock fixture, not its full 900-second and switch flow.
review.failures: Retained failures include a Lobby startup GPU page fault, querying paths inside a solid box, stale collision navigation geometry, an incorrect safety-container drop expectation, timed obstruction delayed by snapshot recording, and construction-script overrides not persisting. A later packaged route caught capsule snagging on a detailed entrance stair; the two solid stair variants now use convex movement collision. Focused side/front/opposite-side regression is archived separately with explicit position fixtures. An arbitrary +X lifecycle target offset landed behind a foliage-instanced rock. Read-only camera and muzzle probes confirmed cover; lifecycle now chooses a navigable candidate with unobstructed rays before firing.
review.versioning: Cook outputs are fresh independent filesystem directories. DDC is shared. Source assets and code hashes, package hashes, process exit results, and original logs are retained.
